messages:
Maya: Heads-up 90m 97 Acme's procurement flagged a mismatch between the vendor risk form and the DPA we returned. The form requests "EU-only processing" but our DPA has the standard "global processing" box checked. Can Legal confirm if we can offer EU-only for hosted API?
Diego: Do we know what exact data classes they send? That determines whether EU-only is feasible w/o Private/Dedicated.
Oliver (Acme): Quick intro from Acme side 97 we send hashed_user_id, prompts, and model responses. No raw PHI/SSNs. Procurement prefers EU-only for GDPR comfort.
Maya: That preference might become a renewal blocker if not resolved pre-signature. Legal, can you advise on scope we can commit to and any audit obligations?
LegalBot: New ticket LR-2026-104 created. Assigning to @Anika for ops impacts and @Diego for security controls. ETA 72h.
Anika: Ops note: EU-only routing requires pinning to eu-1 region and could reduce available burst capacity. We'll outline perf delta and a modest surcharge.
Diego: Security details: Hosted API supports encryption in transit and at rest. BYOK is only available on Dedicated/Private; hosted can support EU KMS scoping but not full customer-managed HSM. Need to confirm if Acme requires BYOK or just EU-residency for keys.
Oliver (Acme): Procurement is asking for customer-managed keys in EU. Is that an absolute requirement to proceed?
Maya: If BYOK is mandatory, we'd recommend Dedicated or Private. If they accept scoped EU KMS, we might keep them on hosted. Ops and Legal, what's the customer-facing language we can offer as a middle ground?
LegalBot: Drafting an addendum with an "EU-only processing" clause that references our standard hosted controls plus an optional BYOK addendum for Dedicated/Private. Posting draft: https://legal.redwood.internal/LR-2026-104
Anika: I'll prepare two handouts for the call: (1) EU-hosted tradeoffs (latency, throughput, costs), (2) Dedicated/Private pros/cons and pricing delta.
Diego: Also request a redacted sample payload or data flow diagram from Acme so we can validate PII/non-PII handling. Even a short snippet helps.
Oliver (Acme): Sharing sanitized flow below:
```
Mobile client -> Redwood hosted API (eu-1) -> model -> ephemeral cache -> analytics (eu-1) -> S3 (eu-1, encrypted)
Payload fields: hashed_user_id, prompt_text, model_response
```
Diego: Good. That confirms we can map keys to EU residency for stored objects. I'll note that BYOK is a Dedicated/Private capability and include fallback language.
Maya: I'll schedule a 30m sync with Acme + procurement + our legal/security/ops tomorrow 10:00 CET. Can everyone attend?
Oliver (Acme): Confirmed. Procurement will be on the invite.
DeployBot: Heads-up: doc PR for eu-1 routing and KMS notes is awaiting review (#pr-3198).
Maya: Action items captured: [Legal] finalize EU-only DPA addendum draft, [Diego] security note + BYOK fallback, [Anika] ops handouts + pricing delta, [Maya] schedule call and send agenda. Target: get a signable DPA before the signature pass next week.
Oliver (Acme): Appreciate the quick turnaround 97 this is a key renewal for us.
Maya: Noted renewal risk flag on account and pinged renewals to monitor. Will post call notes after the sync. :thumbsup:
